photos.name: focaccia-with-chili
photos.summary: Piece of sourdough-turned-focaccia held over a bowl of chili. Golden-brown bottom crust with parmesan, paler top. Dense but airy crumb visible in cross-section. Topped with oregano, garlic powder, and shredded parmesan. Bowl of chili with beans, corn, and avocado visible below.
